description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for a functioncontour graphics object.

tr.td: updates annotation metadata used by graphics inspection.
Type: graphics annotation object or empty handle value. Supported values: annotation handle or empty handle.
reports object deletion state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls callback queuing while another callback is running.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'queue', 'cancel'.
runs when the object receives a mouse-button event.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
stores child graphics handles.
Type: graphics object handle vector. Supported values: empty vector or child handles.
controls clipping to the parent axes.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
attaches a context menu to the object.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a uicontextmenu handle.
stores generated contour segment data.
Type: numeric matrix. Supported values: [] or a contour matrix.
runs when the object is created.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
updates interactive data tip content.
Type: data tip template object or empty handle value. Supported values: data tip template handle or empty handle.
runs when the object is deleted.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
sets the label used by legends and object identification.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets contour line transparency.
Type: numeric scalar. Supported values: values in [0, 1].
sets the internal contour line color.
Type: color value. Supported values: RGB triplet, short or long color name, 'flat', 'interp', or 'none'.
sets filled contour transparency.
Type: numeric scalar or text value. Supported values: values in [0, 1], 'flat', or 'interp'.
sets filled contour color.
Type: color value. Supported values: RGB triplet, short or long color name, 'flat', 'interp', or 'none'.
controls whether contour bands are filled.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls whether contours use their level as z-coordinate.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
sets the function sampled to generate contours.
Type: function handle. Supported values: scalar function handle with two inputs.
controls handle discovery.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off', 'callback'.
controls whether the object can receive pointer events.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
controls whether callbacks can be interrupted.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
sets contour label color.
Type: color value. Supported values: RGB triplet, short or long color name, 'flat', 'interp', or 'none'.
sets contour label formatting.
Type: text value or function handle. Supported values: format text, string scalar, or function handle.
sets spacing between contour labels.
Type: numeric scalar. Supported values: finite nonnegative values.
sets contour levels.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: real finite level values.
selects automatic or manual contour levels.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
sets spacing between generated contour levels.
Type: numeric scalar. Supported values: finite positive values.
selects automatic or manual level spacing.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
sets contour line color.
Type: color value. Supported values: RGB triplet, short or long color name, 'flat', 'interp', or 'none'.
sets contour line style.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: '-', '--', ':', '-.', or 'none'.
sets contour line width.
Type: numeric scalar. Supported values: finite positive values.
sets the number of sample points in each direction.
Type: positive integer scalar. Supported values: integers greater than one.
sets the parent axes.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: axes handle.
controls which parts can receive pointer events.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'visible', 'all', 'none'.
sets object selection state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls selection highlighting.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
controls contour label display.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
stores user text for object identification.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets contour levels that receive labels.
Type: numeric vector. Supported values: real finite level values.
selects automatic or manual labeled levels.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
sets spacing between labeled contour levels.
Type: numeric scalar. Supported values: finite positive values.
selects automatic or manual label spacing.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
reports the graphics object type.
Type: read-only text. Supported values: 'functioncontour'.
stores user data on the object.
Type: any Nelson value. Supported values: any value.
controls object visibility.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
stores sampled x-coordinates.
Type: numeric matrix. Supported values: real numeric matrix matching YData and ZData.
selects automatic or manual x-coordinate data.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
stores the x-data source expression.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets the sampled x-interval.
Type: two-element numeric vector. Supported values: finite increasing limits.
selects automatic or manual x-range limits.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
stores sampled y-coordinates.
Type: numeric matrix. Supported values: real numeric matrix matching XData and ZData.
selects automatic or manual y-coordinate data.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
stores the y-data source expression.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets the sampled y-interval.
Type: two-element numeric vector. Supported values: finite increasing limits.
selects automatic or manual y-range limits.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'auto', 'manual'.
stores sampled function values.
Type: numeric matrix. Supported values: real numeric matrix matching XData and YData.
stores the z-data source expression.
Type: text value. Supported values: character row vector or string scalar.
sets the z-plane used to draw the contours.
Type: numeric scalar or text value. Supported values: finite scalar, 'zmin', or 'zmax'.

example_item.example_item_data: h = fcontour(@(x, y) x.^2 - y.^2); names = properties(h);
